verdict.rationale: Docs confirm percentage rollouts with consistent hash-based bucketing (docs-33, docs-47) and rules that can 'scope, ramp, and schedule' (docs-22), plus a dedicated 'Ramp schedules' feature is called out in the Pro tier (docs-16/37). This covers progressive rollout and consistent bucketing conceptually, but the automated 1%→100% ramp scheduling is gated to paid plans and no walkthrough or hands-on example of the actual ramp workflow is shown. Missing for 10: a concrete doc/example of configuring a ramp schedule from 1% to 100%, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the ramp feature working as advertised.
